messages:
maria_ops: Starting staged rollout: CUDA toolkit 11.8 -> 12.2 images to prod-gpu. Rebuilds pushed to registry, will trigger node drains. @sam_gpu @li_dev please monitor jobs for runtime errors. ETA ~20m.
infra-bot: image-builder: pushed redwood/runtime-cuda:12.2 (sha256:3f7a...) :white_check_mark:
sam_gpu: seeing a few pods CrashLoopBackOff on node gpu-8a with 'Illegal instruction (core dumped)'. quick log snippet: 
```
/workspace/app: line 1 12345 Illegal instruction (core dumped)
[...]
RuntimeError: cuSolver internal error
```
li_dev: also getting 'CUDA driver version is insufficient for CUDA runtime' on two nodes in eu-west despite nvidia-smi showing driver 515.35. snippet: 
```
$ kubectl exec -it job-xyz -- nvidia-smi
Thu Mar 18 12:04:11 2026
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| NVIDIA-SMI 515.35       Driver Version: 515.35       CUDA Version: 11.8     |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
Error: CUDA driver version is insufficient for CUDA runtime
```
raj_sre: sounds like a driver/runtime mismatch or a build toolchain issue. Did the new images get built with a different GCC that emits newer CPU instr? which GPUs are impacted?
maria_ops: Hold rollout for stage-2. Please stop draining remaining nodes while we triage.
sam_gpu: Impacted nodes: gpu-8a, gpu-10b (older Ampere with specific microcode). Build metadata: base image used debian:bookworm + gcc-13 by default. ldd shows libcudart -> /usr/local/cuda/lib64/libcudart.so. But symbols look okay. Could be instruction set collision.
li_dev: we also have NCCL hangs in multi-node tests in eu-west. Logs show repeated timeouts during AllReduce: 
```
NCCL WARN Call to 10.0.0.12:12988 failed: AllReduce timed out
NCCL INFO Possibly stalled, retrying
```
maria_ops: infra-bot, revert tag redwood/runtime-cuda:12.2 -> 11.8 for remaining rollout targets.
infra-bot: orchestrator: rollback initiated for pool=prod-gpu-stage-2 by maria_ops at 1791234620
raj_sre: I'll run a host driver inventory across regions. In parallel, recommend we build a hotfix image compiled with gcc-11 and include compatibility symlinks for libcuda. Also set LD_PRELOAD stubs if needed.
sam_gpu: pushed quick hotfix image redwood/runtime-cuda:12.2-hotfix-gcc11 with CC=gcc-11 and an extra /usr/local/cuda/lib64/libcuda.so.1 -> /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libcuda.so symlink. smoke tests on gpu-8a look green so far :eyes:
maria_ops: good. After we validate canary for 30m, we can resume staged rollout but only to nodes with driver >= 520. We'll need a separate maintenance plan to bump drivers in eu-west.
li_dev: note: kernel ABI vs driver mismatch can surface when moving to driver 525 on older 5.10 kernels. Coordinate with eng-sre for kernel upgrades.
raj_sre: inventory job running. early results: eu-west mix of 515/520, eu-central mostly 525, na-west 515. I'll post the CSV in the eng-infra drive.
maria_ops: thanks. Action items: (1) keep rollback for remaining nodes, (2) validate hotfix image for 1hr on canary, (3) schedule driver bump windows per region. Post any new failures here. :thumbsup:
